name: t3code
description: The open-source control plane for coding agents. Runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok Build, Antigravity, Kiro, Pi, Muse Code, fx on your machine — controlled from desktop, web, or phone.

core_concepts.Thread: A coding session with history, permissions, and source control state
core_concepts.Provider: Agent adapter — t3code speaks ACP (Agent Control Protocol) to any supported agent
core_concepts.Worktree: Each thread can work in its own git worktree for isolated experimentation
core_concepts.Permission Modes: Safe/Suggested/Elevated — controls what the agent can execute without confirmation
core_concepts.Remote Access: Phone/app connects over local network, Tailscale, or T3 Connect relay
core_concepts.ACP Registry: Standardized protocol between t3code server and coding agents
core_concepts.SnapShots: Visual state capture of threads for review/share

supported_providers.Cursor: VS Code fork with AI baked in

architecture.Server: Node.js backend (apps/server) — manages threads, credentials, agent connections
architecture.Desktop: Electron app (apps/desktop) — native UI, system tray, keyboard shortcuts
architecture.Web: React/Vite frontend (apps/web) — browser client for threads
architecture.Mobile: Native iOS/Android apps connecting back to server
architecture.Providers: ACP-based adapters in packages/provider-* for each coding agent
architecture.Secrets: 1Password connect, system keychain, env file support
architecture.Source Control: Multi-VCS (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Forgejo, TanStack Source)
